title: Community
description: I lead one of the largest developer communities in Pakistan, decentralizing mentorship and technical resources into 2nd-tier cities to bridge the urban-rural tech divide.

jobs.details:
Google Developer Group (GDG) Live Pakistan is one of the largest and most active GDG chapters in the region. A nationwide tech community of 50,000+ developers, students, and technology enthusiasts that we have been building to connect digital Pakistan through events, workshops, and knowledge-sharing around Google technologies.
As a community lead, I have led programs where we have;
→ Organized 70+ meetups, trainings, and technical sessions featuring speakers from Google, major tech companies, and local startups.
→ Established partnerships with multiple organizations including universities, startups, accelerators, and government programs
→ Onboarded Google Developer Experts, and industry leaders to support chapter activities
→ Built and managed a four-department team (Events, Design, Marketing, Outreach) to scale operations nationally
→ Championed diversity and inclusion initiatives, driving a 30-50% participation and engagement from female and underrepresented groups
→ Trained 12000+ community members and startups, helping them advance their skills and careers in tech
→ Executed developer upskilling programs like AI Seekho, Cloud Seekho and Android Study Jams, resulting in 10,000+ developers gaining hands-on experience
→ Led flagship events like DevFest, attracting attendees with top speakers from Google and the wider tech industry

Flutter Lahore is a local community meetup group with a focus on helping developers in Flutter, Firebase, and Google Cloud
→ Leading the chapter and organizing different meetups and workshops
→ Building a local community ecosystem for Flutter developers in Lahore & surroundings
Founded a local tech community in Sahiwal to provide mentorship, resources, and networking opportunities for aspiring developers in the region.

Google Developer Student Clubs (GDSC) are university based community groups for students interested in Google developer technologies.
→ Lead a team for planning & hosting different workshops
→ Made an impact on students by guiding & supporting them to learn new skills and get hands-on experience with Google Technologies.
